items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: There’s a clarinet track, I sing a couple, Bob sings one or two.

ctx.x: And you play trombone, and cornet and you do some vocal, some tenor sax. Well I’ll look forward to hearing this.
Yeah. There’s a clarinet track, I sing a couple, Bob sings one or two.
And you do some arrangements too.
